label: The Burning Crusade
years: a year or two after Vanilla
present: The world is Azeroth after the Dark Portal has opened again, with news from Outland and the Burning Legion's old shadow, while Horde and Alliance take sides in a new war.
world: The Dark Portal is open: the broken world of Outland holds Illidan, the Legion's servants, the draenei exiles and the rebuilt Shattrath. The blood elves of Silvermoon, led by Lor'themar, have joined the Horde; the draenei of the Exodar stand with the Alliance. The Shattered Sun Offensive fights for the Sunwell. Kael'thas has fallen to the Legion. At home, the old Plaguelands wars simmer.
idiom: Folk speak of the Dark Portal, the Nether, the naaru and the Light; the draenei say the Light's blessings; blood elves sing of the Sunwell. Coin is gold, silver and copper; Badges and Shards are fighters' tokens.

folk.alliance: You know the draenei of the Exodar as new allies and the blood elves as Horde, scarred and proud; Outland is a hard road beyond the Dark Portal.
folk.horde: You know the blood elves of Silvermoon as your new allies, hungry for magic and the Sunwell; Outland is the new frontier of your war.
folk.neutral: You trade with both camps; Shattrath's Aldor and Scryers divide the city but welcome coin.

classes.death knight: No such knights exist; the Lich King's champions are a tale from the north.
classes.monk: A monk is a wanderer, not a calling you know.
classes.demon hunter: Illidan's followers are a rumour of Outland, feared as outcasts.

races.worgen: Worgen are still the wolf-monsters of Silverpine.
races.goblin: Goblins are neutral cartel traders and, in places, mercenaries.
races.pandaren: A pandaren is a rare wanderer, no more.
races.zandalari: Zandalari are an old empire of legend.
races.kultiran: Kul Tiras is a distant sealord kingdom.
races.darkiron: Dark Iron dwarves are an enemy clan.
races.magharorc: Mag'har are the orcs of Outland, who have never joined the Horde's trappings; some have met them.

stances.horde>bloodelf: The Horde accepts the blood elves, though the orcs and trolls roll their eyes at their pride and magic-thirst.
stances.alliance>bloodelf: The Alliance sees the blood elves as an enemy new to the Horde: proud, haughty and mana-addicted.
stances.alliance>draenei: The Alliance welcomes the draenei as new allies with strange wisdom and a long exile.

places.dalaran: A crater and a ruin; the Kirin Tor's scattered mages gather at Karazhan and Shattrath.
places.stormwind: Stormwind: a rebuilt capital with the Exodar's draenei as new allies.
places.brill: Brill: the Forsaken's village of Tirisfal, the Horde's northern gate.
places.dolanaar: Dolanaar: the Teldrassil village at the world tree's foot.
